annotations.title: Record a review of one exact site version

description: Reviewer token only. Records pass or revise for one exact version of a site (from list_reviews). The operator token can publish only a version whose latest review is a pass; any edit makes a new version.

items.description: What must change (up to 50 short items). Required in practice for revise.

note.description: Optional summary of the review (up to 2000 characters).

verdict.description: pass lets the operator publish this exact version; revise blocks it until a new version passes.

version.description: The exact version you reviewed: current_draft_version (before publish_site) or current_staged_version (before publish_staged) from list_reviews. Any later edit makes a new version that needs its own review.

name: record_review
title: Record a review of one exact site version
